APPROVE
The extractions are behaviour-preserving (the lazy `Where(reported.Add)` runs after `DistinctBy` in the same order as the old `continue`) and drop roughly 16 complexity points, leaving about 13. I couldn't find the repo locally, though, so I haven't confirmed that `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation` and `JsInventory.Inventory` are the real type names, and a build is needed to confirm that.
